method: Every production reference to structuralNodeIds (or an equivalent linked-node array) in lib/ and app/, found by exhaustive grep, classified by what it does with element [1..]. 10 production files, 12 consumer sites, plus 7 sites that consume the over-wide TEXT rather than the array. Scripts are listed separately because they are harness, not production.

consumers.shouldKeepReceivingLinkedNodes: not as operative text; the array itself stays on the candidate for C2-C12
consumers.note: THE ONE SITE THAT TREATS THE LINK AS A SPAN. This is the whole change.

consumers.site: deriveOperativeLineage - worst supersession status across every structuralNodeId
consumers.shouldKeepReceivingLinkedNodes: YES - conservative worst-status is correct for a linked node too
consumers.note: Reads the array, not the text. Untouched.
Already anchor-first - independent confirmation that [0] is the anchor by construction.

consumers.shouldKeepReceivingLinkedNodes: YES, but typed PARENT_SCOPE rather than a second OPERATIVE_SOURCE
consumers.note: SAFETY_FOLLOWUP (F1), not REQUIRED. It types the linked parent's full subtree as OPERATIVE_SOURCE inside the bundle. Measured redundancy: retrieveParentScope already emits the same parent as PARENT_SCOPE for 67/67 dual CONMED candidates at a mean 319 chars (OWN text) instead of the subtree. Leaving C4 alone keeps the first change strictly context-preserving - nothing a compiler sees today disappears.
compile.ts reads [0] of this as the accountability anchorNodeId; unchanged.

consumers.shouldKeepReceivingLinkedNodes: YES - REQUIRED, this is what keeps the parent covered
consumers.note: Reads the array, never the text. Because the proposal does not touch the array, package coverage is bit-identical.
The package coverage map. Unchanged by construction.

consumers.site: candidatesCoveringUnit - unit's node IS one of the candidate's nodes or nested under one

consumers.note: Not changed: the link is correct and useful; only its consumption at C1 is wrong.

consumers.site: mergeKey from structuralNodeIds[0]; NEIGHBORHOOD_EXPANSION; union on merge
consumers.note: Candidate identity is already anchor-only, so the proposal changes NO discoveryId.
discoveryId is unchanged, so every ClaimReviewEvent identity is stable across the change.

consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.effect: renders operativeSourceText as the prompt's 'Operative source text' block
consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.underProposal: shrinks to the anchor text; the parent still reaches the model in the adjacent 'Already-gathered context' block as a typed PARENT_SCOPE item

consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.effect: the OPERATIVE region and the per-candidate sourceCoverage / unaccountedSource computed over it
consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.underProposal: the child accounts for its own text only; the parent is accounted for by the parent's own candidate (verified: 70/70 appended parents across the four datasets are themselves anchored candidates)

consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.effect: units and shards derived from the OPERATIVE region
the SOURCE side of the independent reconciliation
consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.underProposal: window narrows to the anchor text - this is the false-credit fix (05-false-credit-span-probe.json)

consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.effect: classifyConditionSuspicion(operativeSourceText) - Gate 2, the only gate that can permit a review skip
consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.underProposal: a condition living only in the chapeau leaves its window -> REQUIRED mitigation R3

consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.effect: operativeSourceText participates in the compile cache key
consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.underProposal: every affected candidate's key changes once - a one-time cold cache, no correctness effect

consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.effect: precedent retrieval signature over the operative text
consumersOfTheOverWideTextRatherThanTheA.underProposal: signatures become anchor-scoped, i.e. more specific; no safety claim depends on the wider text

scriptHarnessConsumers.note: scripts/p3-conmed-pilot/pipeline.ts:135-137 reproduces C1 exactly and must change with it (R2); the other 20 construct single-node candidates or read the array for reporting only.
